title: Warehouse Team Leader
description:
Kernverantwoordelijkheden
1.Leidinggeven en Teamcoördinatie
•    Dagelijkse aansturing, coaching en ondersteuning van een team van 3 medewerkers.
•    Opstellen van werkplanningen en taakverdeling.
•    Bevorderen van een veilige, gestructureerde en positieve werkomgeving.
2.Orderverwerking
•    Accuraat pikken, controleren en verpakken van binnenkomende dagelijkse orders.
•    Bewaken van kwaliteit en volledigheid van bestellingen.
•    Waarborgen van tijdige verzending en correcte documentatie.
3.Voorraadbeheer
•    Monitoren en beheren van voorraden, inclusief systeemregistratie.
•    Uitvoeren van periodieke tellingen en voorraadcorrecties.
•    Signaleren van tekorten of afwijkingen en het ondernemen van bijbehorende acties.
4.Naleving van Procedures
•    Werken volgens strikte medische, hygiënische en logistieke richtlijnen.
•    Zorgen voor correcte documentatie, traceerbaarheid en naleving van audits en kwaliteitsstandaarden (bijv. GDP/ISO).
5.Procesverbetering
•    Initiëren en implementeren van verbeteringen in efficiëntie, veiligheid en kwaliteit.
•    Analyseren van knelpunten in logistieke processen en voorstellen voor optimalisatie.
•    Rapporteren van KPI’s en bijdragen aan continuous improvement.
Benodigde Competenties
•
Leiderschap
– In staat om een klein team effectief aan te sturen, te motiveren en te ontwikkelen.
•
Organisatorisch vermogen
– Sterk in plannen, prioriteren en overzicht houden.
•
Nauwkeurigheid & kwaliteitsbewustzijn
– Zeer zorgvuldig werken binnen strikte medische en logistieke voorschriften.
•
Communicatieve vaardigheden
– Helder instrueren, afstemmen en rapporteren.
•
Probleemoplossend vermogen
– Knelpunten snel herkennen en praktische oplossingen implementeren.
•
Procesgerichtheid & continuous improvement
– Gericht op optimalisatie en efficiëntieverbetering.
•
Samenwerkingsvaardigheden
– Prettig en effectief samenwerken met teamleden en andere afdelingen.
•
Kennis van relevante regelgeving (GDP/ISO)
– Begrip van medische logistieke richtlijnen en het strikt toepassen ervan.
•
Hands-on mentaliteit
– Bereidheid om actief mee te werken op de werkvloer en zelf het voorbeeld te geven.
•
Stressbestendigheid
– Goed kunnen functioneren onder tijdsdruk en bij piekbelasting.
•
Verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel
– Sterk gevoel van eigenaarschap over processen, voorraad en teamresultaten.
Opleidingsniveau
•    MBO-4 werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur richting Logistiek, Supply Chain of een vergelijkbare opleiding.
•    HBO-niveau is een pré, maar niet vereist bij voldoende relevante ervaring.
Werkervaring
•    3–5 jaar ervaring in een logistieke of magazijnomgeving.
•    Ervaring in de medische, farmaceutische of sterk gereguleerde sector is een grote plus.
•    Aantoonbare ervaring met leidinggeven in een operationele omgeving.
•    Ervaring met voorraadbeheer en magazijnsystemen (ERP/WMS) is gewenst.
•    Goede beheersing van de Engelse taal.
Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten komen in aanmerking voor werkgelegenheid, ongeacht ras, huidskleur, religie, geslacht, seksuele geaardheid, genderidentiteit, nationale herkomst of handicap.

title: Product Manager (Straumann) - Benelux
description:
The role
As Product Marketing Manager (Benelux), you are responsible for driving the commercial success of your assigned portfolio in the local market. You translate global strategy into strong local execution through a clear strategy, positioning, effective go-to-market plans, impactful launches, and close collaboration with Sales, Training & Education, and key stakeholders.
You play a central role in shaping how our solutions are positioned, adopted, and grown in Benelux — connecting product, customer needs, education, and commercial execution. This role carries joint commercial accountability, with a clear contribution to pipeline, revenue, and growth targets, and requires both strategic thinking and strong hands-on execution. All marketing activity is expected to directly support commercial growth.
Key responsibilities
1. Go-to-market & commercial ownership
Own and execute the annual go-to-market and marketing plan for your portfolio, clearly linked to commercial priorities, pipeline contribution, and revenue growth.
Act as a commercial driver, ensuring marketing activities generate demand, support adoption, and accelerate Sales performance.
Share joint accountability with Sales for portfolio performance.
Build business cases, forecasts, and success criteria for launches; track pipeline impact, revenue contribution, and ROI.
Use CRM, dashboards, and performance data to steer priorities.
2. Launch excellence & lifecycle marketing
Lead end-to-end local launch execution.
Ensure launches are clear, on time and actionable for Sales.
Drive lifecycle initiatives that support adoption and growth.
3. Portfolio positioning & solution storytelling
Define positioning, value propositions, and messaging.
Build solution and workflow-based storytelling.
Maintain strong competitive understanding.
4. KOL strategy, engagement & management
Develop and execute the Benelux KOL strategy for your portfolio  in collaboration with the T&E manager.
Build and manage relationships with key opinion leaders in association with sales.
Use KOL insights to strengthen messaging and education.
5. Training & Education collaboration
Work closely with Training & Education teams.
Shape training priorities aligned with customer journey & commercial needs.
Support internal and customer-facing education.
6. Sales enablement & field collaboration
Partner closely with Sales.
Support co-travels, key customer meetings, and events.
Proactively identify initiatives to close pipeline gaps.
7. Market insight & performance tracking
Monitor market trends and customer needs.
Support market studies and pilots.
Provide performance insights to stakeholders.
8. Cross-functional collaboration
Work across Sales, Marketing, T&E, Customer Care, Finance, and global teams.
Act as the link between local and global stakeholders.
What success looks like
Strong pipeline and revenue contribution.
Effective launches with measurable impact.
Clear solution-led messaging.
Strong Sales alignment.
Clear visibility on ROI and performance.
What we’re looking for:
Education / Experience / Skills / Languages
Bachelor’s degree (HBO / WO or equivalent) in Marketing, Product Management, Business Administration, or a closely related field.
A Master’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related discipline is preferred.
Additional training or certification in Product Marketing, Product Management, or Commercial Strategy is an advantage.
6–10 years in Product Marketing, Product Management, or similar roles.
Experience in medical devices, dental, or healthcare.
Proven matrix and launch experience.
Strong commercial mindset.
Ability to simplify complexity.
Strong execution skills.
Confident communicator.
Fluent Dutch and English.
French is a plus.

title: Head of Enterprise Solutions - Northern Hub
description:
The role mandates to achieve yearly DSO P&L targets and at the same time to support the DSO department’s long-term strategic plan for Straumann Group EMEA. A key parameters for success includes alignment, negotiation and collaboration with Hub and country leadership.
This position can be based anywhere within the Northern Hub -
Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, Netherlands, Belgium, United Kingdom!
Main Tasks and Responsibilities
Lead DSO Hub P&L (topline / OPEX)
Manage operational performance across the value chain to generate topline growth, market share and SoW increase
Ensure optimized go-to-market execution taking into account market insights, local ecosystem specifics and available resources (works closely with Hub Leader to optimize resources allocation and boost win rate)
Responsible for excellence in execution of international deals in Hub countries (works closely with International Strategic Enterprise Accounts Lead)
Act as a thought partner for DSO Strategic Business initiatives if any in the Hub countries (works closely with EMEA Marketing Team and Global DSO ES Team when required)
Devise with Hub Leader and the Hub LT the cross-selling marketing strategy for DSO and appropriate Hub/local communication plan with resource allocation
Responsible for DSO Commercial Excellence at Hub level: pricing strategy, commercial policy, incentive scheme in alignment and agreement with Hub Leader
Responsible for DSO sales forecast accuracy and excellence: ensures DSO sales funnel is built and updated in every Hub country on a weekly basis and reviewed during Monthly Business Reviews and Quarterly Latest Estimate (LE) sales landing flagging risks & opportunities is provided by Country DSO Head and presented at QBR
Ensure DSO Strategic Account Management strategy is rolled out in every Hub country (Tools adoption, Account strategy and account planning in place and Integrated Account Team defined for every customer)
Ensure excellence in execution of Customer/Business Engagement Process in Hub countries in collaboration with local team (roles & responsibilities defined at country level )
Ensure Development Plan is in place for every DSO Team member within the Hub
Responsible for building the local DSO selling process in collaboration with local team and implementation framework
Provides vision and passion to the local team to empower local DSO organization in the pursuit of DSO opportunities
Requirements
Education & Experience
Master Degree in a relevant field of work or an equivalent combination of education and work related experience, preferably a business degree
Extensive experience (at least 8 years) within a Sales, Business Development or Commercial role with proven commercial success from preferably medical devices field
Experience within business consultancy frameworks and consultative selling techniques utilizing data that enable new business cases and new commercial opportunities
Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Every additional language is a plus
Comfortable with up to 40% (international/national) traveling
Personal Attributes
Energetic, straight forward and performance-driven professional with entrepreneurial spirit and strong sales commercial and execution abilities
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a matrix environment
Strong presentation, negotiation and excellent communication skills
Leadership experience (3+ years experience in a leadership role, experienced in talent development and retention, performance management and coaching)
Ability to celebrate successes and inspire a motivational team environment
Analytical thinking and high degree of ease with figures and financial information in order to analyze and identify trends and sales patterns to make use of them to localize and implement successful sales strategies
Effective relationship builder at executive level as well as internal stakeholders (e.g. Regional / Hub Business Units Leads)
Excellent time management, decision-making and project management abilities

title: Key Account Mananger - DSO
description:
Your Responsibilities
Customer Success & Value Realization
Develop and execute success plans for DSOs and their clinic networks, including defined outcomes, milestones, and adoption metrics.
Ensure customers achieve measurable value from Straumann products, services, and digital workflows.
Monitor adoption, usage, and operational health indicators across multiple clinics.
Onboarding & Enablement
Lead structured onboarding programs for new DSO customers and clinic rollouts.
Collaborate closely with Area Sales Management and Account Management teams to coordinate multi-site implementations of Straumann solutions across DSO networks.
Organize and manage training programs, adoption campaigns, and user enablement initiatives.
Support clinics with user management, onboarding processes, and best practices for digital workflows.
Operational Governance
Support Head of DSO with regular business reviews with DSO leadership and key stakeholders.
Contribute in monthly operational meetings with DSO leadership following the respective onboarding playbook.
Track operational performance, adoption levels, and value realization against success plans.
Align stakeholders across clinics, DSO leadership, and Straumann internal teams to ensure successful day-to-day operations.
Renewal & Expansion Readiness
Provide customer health insights, adoption data, and value evidence to support renewal and expansion opportunities.
Collaborate closely with Area Sales Management and Account Management teams to identify growth opportunities within the DSO network.
Contribute insights that support cross-selling and long-term strategic partnerships.
Voice of the Customer
Collect structured customer feedback, feature requests, and process improvement opportunities.
Translate customer insights into actionable input for product management, marketing, and service teams.
Advocate internally for improvements that enhance customer experience and outcomes
Cross-Functional Collaboration.
Work closely with, Sales, Marketing, Education, and Customer Service teams.
Support strategic DSO initiatives and ensure consistent execution across Straumann functions.
Your Profile
Bachelor or Master degree in business economics or a related field.
Experience in Key Account Management, Consulting, or Implementation roles, ideally in healthcare or dental markets.
Demonstrated project management skills in coordinating initiatives across distributed teams and locations.
Strong ability to manage complex stakeholder environments and coordinate cross-functional teams.
Experience with implant dentistry, digital platforms, software adoption, or workflow implementation is a strong advantage.
Analytical mindset with the ability to translate usage data and adoption metrics into actionable insights.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, able to explain complex topics clearly.
Strong customer orientation with a consultative and solution-driven mindset.
Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus).

title: Training & Education Manager - Benelux
description:
the Role
The T&E Manager Benelux is responsible for developing and executing a customer-centric education and KOL strategy that supports business growth across the full customer journey. This includes ensuring that education, KOL engagement, partnerships, and a strategic approach to university collaboration are fully aligned with commercial priorities to drive customer acquisition, development, and loyalty.
The role acts as the central point for education excellence, KOL strategy, speaker management, and university partnerships in Benelux, with co-ownership for developing and managing relationships with key academic institutions. The role works closely with the Head of Marketing, Marketing and Sales teams, global stakeholders, and external partners — including close collaboration with the International Team for Implantology (ITI).
Key Responsibilities
1. Customer Education
Develop and deliver a Benelux education programme that aligns with commercial priorities and supports every stage of the customer journey and covering all segments.
Own the full education lifecycle, including planning, budgeting, execution, and ROI assessment.
Ensure strong linkage between education activities and lead generation, conversion, and customer growth.
Utilise and further develop our own Straumann Benelux programme. the global curricula, as well as the curriculum of partners such as the ITI, universities and KOLs and adapt these to Benelux market needs.
Continuously improve education programmes & formats using customer feedback and performance insights.
2. KOL Management
Define and implement a Benelux KOL programme aligned to business priorities.
Identify, support,  develop, and retain high-potential KOLs across multiple brands, segments and markets.
Build and maintain a structured KOL database, ensuring segmentation and strategic deployment.
Act as the primary point of contact for KOL engagement internally and externally.
Ensure KOL utilisation is aligned to campaigns, education, and commercial priorities.
3. Internal Training
Develop a structured and effective approach to internal product trainings aligned to product launches, campaigns, and strategic priorities.
Support onboarding and continuous development of commercial teams.
Collaborate with global and regional teams to ensure consistency and best practice sharing.
4. Speaker Programme & Database Management
Maintain speaker database.
Collect speaker information such as CVs, portrait pictures and other useful information.
Manage speaker agreements together with ASM.
Actively coordinate speaker activities.
Align with internal stakeholders and speakers on presentation topics.
Update speaker profiles and help to select speakers according to their profile.
Brief speakers before the event and de-brief after the event.
5. ITI Collaboration & External Partnerships
Act as the key liaison with the ITI (International Team for Implantology) in Benelux.
Support and collaborate closely with ITI Netherlands and ITI Belgium associations.
Integrate ITI activities into the overall Straumann education strategy.
Leverage ITI as a core channel for customer engagement, education, and KOL development.
Ensure strong coordination between ITI, Marketing, and Sales for follow-up and impact.
6. University & Academic Partnerships
Develop and manage strategic partnerships with universities and educational institutions in Benelux.
Identify opportunities to embed Straumann solutions into academic curricula.
Build long-term relationships with key academic stakeholders.
Collaborate on joint education programmes and talent development initiatives.
Support the development of future clinicians and KOL pipeline.
7. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance
Work closely with Marketing, Sales, and Product Management to align education with growth priorities.
Ensure strong handover and follow-up processes between education activities and Sales.
Establish clear KPIs to track education impact (leads, engagement, pipeline influence).
Act as the Benelux interface for global and regional T&E teams.
Experience/knowledge/qualifications:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree.
5-8  years of experience in healthcare/medical device industry (Dental industry a plus).
Experience in organizing seminars, training courses or similar events.
Experience in KOL management, education programmes, and partnerships.
Personal Values/Attributes/Behaviours
Excellent communication skills (internally and with customers).
English (Business level) a must.
Interpersonal and presentation skills.
Well-organized and structured.
Comfortable to interact with different stakeholders and customers.
Target orientated.
PC skills: MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Sharepoint).
